name: Dowsing Machine
description: A device that signals an invisible item by sound.

gifts.note: Beat Cynthia. Partway up Route 110, on the way from Slateport City to Mauville City, your rival Cynthia stops you for a battle. Win and she gives you the Dowsing Machine, which finds hidden items. The battle can't be avoided and she waits for a rematch if you lose, so it can't be missed.
